cases.rationale: The PP profile requires a D3163 joint-strength method but does not force optional failure classification.
The same profile can optionally add the general ISO failure-pattern ontology.
D5868 is not the registered rigid-plastic test method for this profile.
FRP-to-FRP uses D5868 for joint strength and ISO 10365 for general failure-pattern description.
D3163 rigid-plastic evidence cannot underwrite an FRP-to-FRP strength claim.
D5573 remains scoped to the SMC FRP classification use case.
SMC-FRP classification scope cannot be attached to a rigid-plastic PP profile.
D5656 is admitted as adhesive constitutive response in its thick aluminum adherend scope.
A constitutive-response method cannot satisfy a joint-strength claim family.
Conditioning protocol and post-condition strength measurement bind the same specimen IDs.
Aged strength claim cannot be present without its conditioning evidence role.
Conditioning and post-condition strength data do not identify the same physical specimens.
A required claim cannot silently disappear from the evidence dossier.
The optional classification role is not forced onto a profile that does not claim it.
The profile digest must be the hash of the exact frozen claim contract.
Evidence cannot add a post-hoc undeclared product claim.
The evidence must use the exact edition pinned by its role.
The same claim/role cannot be filled twice.
A single raw artifact cannot satisfy distinct evidence roles.
A claim family without a declared method/evidence role is incomplete.
A receipt cannot satisfy an undeclared method role.
A surface-state profile can qualify wettability as its own claim without asserting bond strength.
A low contact angle cannot satisfy a joint-strength claim.
The method receipt endpoint must match the exact claim role.
D3163 joint-strength evidence cannot be repackaged as a failure-pattern classification claim.
An optional D5573 role cannot be declared for a rigid-plastic PP profile, even when no outcome has yet been supplied.
A generic quality-score family cannot bypass the typed claim-family registry.
